name: Jetking Infotrain Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1983, Jetking Infotrain Ltd is in the business of IT Training in Hardware, Networking, and Digital courses[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
The company serves two key customer segments: students, primarily high school graduates and engineering aspirants seeking skill-based education, and recruiters, by aligning training with job market requirements to ensure a steady flow of job-ready talent. It offers a full-stack curriculum across Web2 and Web3 technologies, including Cloud Computing, Ethical Hacking, Blockchain & Metaverse, and Intro to AI, addressing future-ready tech skills.

cons: Company has a low return on equity of -1.39% over last 3 years.
Earnings include an other income of Rs.5.37 Cr.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -11.3%
